## Rules

- **Never open this store in place** — an open MIGRATES it, destroying the
  property the fixture exists for. Tests stage a copy in a temp directory.
- Reading it with `sqlite3` rewrites the `-shm`/`-wal` sidecars; the
  `.sqlite` is what carries the evidence.
- To re-derive: `FORCE=1 scripts/capture-store-fixture.sh bc8110a V1_0_2`.

## ⚠️ Which commit is this, really

**This release was never tagged, so the commit is a judgment call, and here is the one that was
made:** `bc8110a` — the last 1.0.2 commit BEFORE the V2 schema landed (`fa1bf77`, 2026-07-21 02:54). The obvious choice — the last commit carrying `MARKETING_VERSION = 1.0.2` (`49d32a9`) — is wrong: it already contains `ZTRANSACTIONSPLIT`, so it is 1.0.3 development that had not been renumbered yet. The first capture used it and was discarded.

The version STRING is not sufficient evidence on its own: it changes when someone remembers to bump
it, not when a build ships. Tag every release (`GO_LIVE_CHECKLIST §3`) and this note stops being
necessary for future versions.
